**Belgium: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 748,040 applications. The largest annual volume was 49,194 in 2015; 2025 recorded 46,920. Applications in 2025 were 264% higher than in 2019 (12,879). In 2025, 38,315 recorded decisions equated to 82 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 0.7% higher than in 2024 (46,583). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 5 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Palestinian (6,080), Afghanistan (4,989), Dem. Rep. of the Congo (3,327).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 27%, across 34,718 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 9.4% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 17.8 percentage points lower than in 2024 (45%).
